posts.text: Decent results from TIPS MUSIC in line with management’s guidance. Some pointers from the investor ppt. worth going over Revenue grew to ₹120.1 crore in Q2 FY27, reflecting YoY growth of 35% over Q2 FY26. Content cost increased to ₹26.2 crore in Q2 FY27 from ₹13.3 crore in Q2 FY26, representing a 97% YoY increase. Profit After Tax (PAT) increased to ₹65.5 crore in Q2 FY27 from ₹53.2 crore in Q2 FY26, reflecting a 23% YoY growth. During Q2 FY27, a total of 73 songs were released, comprising 40 film songs and 33 non-film songs. Strong audience response was seen to the Punjabi music album ’ Ishqn…
